deep.reconstruction:
This page contains no mathematical derivation. It holds two short prose notes at the top (right-side-up) and a long, heavily struck-through pencil draft written upside down at the bottom.

(1) Aphorism, top line: "Das Glauben muß von dem Höchsten (erhabensten), das Wissen vom Geringsten / Niedrigsten ausgehen". In English: belief must start from the highest (most sublime) things, knowledge from the lowest. This is a philosophical remark of the kind found in Riemann's Nachlass fragments on epistemology and Naturphilosophie. There is nothing to compute.

(2) Physics note: "Zur Erklärung der Corrosionen wegen des Randes würden Regeln über die Gestalt der Durchschlags-[?]gewalt, vielleicht einige Ergebnisse [Versuche?] über die Rückstandsbildung im Lack (d. h. wenn der Isolator zw. den Belegungen ... aus einer Schicht desselben Lacks besteht) sehr willkommen sein." In English: to explain the corrosions near the edge, rules about the form of the breakdown (discharge) force, and perhaps some results or experiments on residue formation in varnish, would be very welcome. The parenthesis specifies the case where the insulator between the coatings consists of a layer of the same varnish.

The topic is the electric residue (Rückstand, residual charge) of a Leyden jar or condenser whose dielectric is varnish, and damage at the edges of the coatings. This matches Riemann's known interest around 1854–55. He presented "Über die Gesetze der Vertheilung von Spannungselectricität in ponderablen Körpern, wenn diese nicht als vollkommene Leiter oder Nichtleiter, sondern als dem Enthalten von Spannungselectricität mit endlicher Kraft widerstrebend betrachtet werden" at the Göttingen Naturforscherversammlung in 1854. That work responded to Kohlrausch's measurements of residual charge in Leyden jars. The note reads like a request to an experimenter, plausibly R. Kohlrausch or W. Weber, for data.

(3) Upside-down draft: almost illegible prose, apparently a letter draft dated "Göttingen d. 26 ...". From what is visible it contains no formulas.

The previous page (axially symmetric potential, stream function, hodograph-type inversion) and the next page (Landen/Gauss AGM transformation of elliptic integrals) are unrelated to this page's content.

transcription_corrections: Line 1: read "das Wissen vom Geringsten / Niedrigsten ausgehen". "erhabensten" is an interlinear insertion above "Höchsten", so it qualifies the faith clause, not "Wissen".
Line 3: "Durchschlagsgewalt" is uncertain; it could be "Entladungs-" or "Durchschlags-" followed by "gewalt". The word read as "Ergebnisse" may instead be "Versuche".
Parenthesis: probably "wenn der Isolator zw. den Belegungen [einer Flasche] aus einer Schicht desselben Lacks besteht".
The upside-down bottom text is a struck-through prose (letter) draft; the visible date line reads roughly "Göttingen d. 26 ...".
